title: Assigned variables of a statement
statement: For a statement built from the given syntax, define its assigned-variable list recursively as follows: a skip or a store has the empty list; an assignment to variable $x$ or a procedure call storing its result in $x$ has list $[x]$; sequential composition and conditionals concatenate the lists of their two branches; and a while loop has the list of its body.
